context: Asuka advises a student on study habits.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: study advice; adverbs (きちんと/通常/決して/そういった/とりあえず) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、勉強が続かないんです。
lines.en: Teacher, I can't keep up my studying.
lines.style: troubled adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: まず、きちんと計画を立てましょう。
lines.en: First, let's make a proper plan.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 通常、どれくらい勉強すべきですか?
lines.en: Usually, how much should I study?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 通常は、短くても毎日が大切です。
lines.en: Usually, even short daily study matters.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: どうしても、集中できない日もあって。
lines.en: Some days I just can't concentrate.
lines.style: honest adult student voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そういった日は、とりあえず復習だけでも。
lines.en: On such days, at least just review.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 決して、無理しすぎないようにします。
lines.en: I'll make sure never to overdo it.
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そういった心がけが、力になりますよ。
lines.en: That kind of mindfulness becomes strength.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout
